Application Data.NAME: Main Street Vacuum Co.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Main Street Vacuum Co. specializes in the retail sale and servicing of vacuum cleaners, offering a variety of models including upright, canister, and robotic vacuums. Our operations include product demonstrations, in-store consultations, and repair services carried out by certified technicians. We also provide maintenance packages and accessories to enhance the performance of our products. Our customer base includes residential homes and small businesses seeking reliable cleaning solutions.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES:
Loss Date: 06/15/2023; Cause: Water damage due to a burst pipe affecting the showroom area; Amount: $10,000.00; Status: Closed.  
Loss Date: 09/10/2022; Cause: Theft of vacuum cleaners and accessories during a break-in; Amount: $5,000.00; Status: Closed.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Chain link fencing with a height of 6 feet, monitored by a central station alarm system and regular security patrols during operating hours.
